title: Aureline M5 ring-history snapshot record
description: Canonical per-domain record that preserves the ring history behind a claimed launch-bearing widening event so later incident or support review can reconstruct why a lane widened. Names the snapshot scope (`ring_history_coverage`) — a ring-history scope, a prior-blocker scope, or a packet-freshness scope — and preserves the resolved coverage identity, the ring-history ledger (`rehearsal_evidence_ledger`), the preserved signoff (`orr_signoff_reference`), the named on-call roster state, the previous packet-freshness state (`ring_history_freshness_state`), the authorized widening stage, and the last ring-history revision that justified widening, so prior blockers and previous packet freshness stay queryable and a lane can never imply green while its preserved evidence snapshot is stale or its roster coverage is missing. Downstream shiproom, correction-line, release-center, docs/public-proof, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's ring history by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
